messages:
Nina: Noticed a spike in support tickets this morning complaining sample-app starter crashes with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED after today's release. Most callers are using older Node or commonjs stacks.
Raj: Repro'd on Node 14 with `const r = require('@redwood/inference')` -> package.json exports only had an ESM entry so require() fails. Edge demo (V8 isolate) is fine.
Ollie: We pushed a simplified exports map to reduce ambiguity (`\"exports\": \"./dist/index.mjs\"`) but that breaks legacy require and some bundlers. My bad for not running the compatibility matrix.
Pat: Short-term fix: restore multi-target exports and explicit main/module/types fields. Something like:
```json
"main": "dist/index.cjs",
"module": "dist/index.mjs",
"types": "dist/index.d.ts",
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
Nina: Can we ship a tiny patch (v0.12.1) that adds the require path and types? We should also update the sample app to prefer dynamic `import()` and document Node vs Edge guidance in onboarding.
Raj: I'll prepare the patch. Also adding a smoke test in CI that runs two tiny fixtures: a require() Node14 app and an ESM Cloudflare Worker. CI-bot: created job matrix INF-CI-exports-compat (node14,node16,node18,cloudflare).
Ollie: Reminder: downstream bundlers (webpack/rollup/parcel) sometimes ignore exports and fall back to main/module fields. Having both reduces surprises.
Pat: Note about typing experience: some consumers import types from package root (`import type {Client} from '@redwood/inference'`) so ensure index.d.ts re-exports public types and tsconfig "types" field points to it.
Nina: After patch, update docs/sample-apps and add a short migration note in the SDK changelog: "If you rely on require() upgrade or use v0.12.1+ which restores CJS entry."
Raj: PR up in ~15m, will tag devex and eng-runtime for quick review.
Nina: Thanks. Once merged, re-run sample-app CI and I'll triage any remaining fails. :thumbsup:
Pat: Long-term: add an automated check on PRs that touch package.json/exports to run quick require/import smoke to avoid regressions. Filing ticket DEVEX-721.
CI-bot: patch build started for v0.12.1: https://ci.redwood/patches/789 status: running
Nina: Good catch everyone; this is a nice example of DX + runtime compatibility colliding. We'll follow up with a brief postmortem and some checklist items.
